snippet.title: John Wick small game based on fake NES tribute video to the movies
snippet.description:
This game is based on a fake NES tribute video for the John Wick movie for what might've looked like if a NES game was released back in the day.

The tribute video was made by @Danilo_Noites and @Dominic_Ninmark and the art assets were made available for free use by anyone, so @MuriloDev made this game.
Download:  https://murilodev.itch.io/john-wick
The game was made using the Overplasma engine.
twitter.com/Overplasmagame
